text: @bright-y/dsh-restart（DSH 网页客户端插件）：在 DSH Desktop 会话页提供一键重启入口。它在会话标题右侧工具区加入重启按钮，点击后先显示确认对话框，再向宿主的本机重启路由发出请求。主要功能包括确认后请求桌面宿主重启、显示重启中状态、在不支持的运行环境说明限制，以及在请求失败时提供错误信息和重试。适合需要从 DSH 会话界面快速重新启动桌面应用的用户。使用前需要 DSH Desktop；纯 dsh web 不支持桌面重启。

@bright-y/dsh-restart (DSH web client plugin) adds a session-header restart button. After confirmation, it asks the host to relaunch DSH Desktop and shows unsupported or error states, with retry on failure. It lets users restart from a conversation; plain dsh web is unsupported.
想从 DSH 会话页面直接重启桌面应用。

让 DSH 的会话标题栏提供一个重启入口。

I want a restart control in the session header.
How can I relaunch DSH Desktop without closing it manually?
@bright-y/dsh-restart 的功能「会话页重启按钮」：在对话会话标题右侧工具区显示循环箭头按钮。点击后打开确认对话框；用户确认后提交重启请求。
@bright-y/dsh-restart 的功能「请求桌面重启」：确认操作会向宿主路由发送 POST 请求；宿主返回成功后延迟一小段时间调用桌面重启能力，缺少该能力时返回不支持状态。
@bright-y/dsh-restart 的功能「重启状态与错误提示」：界面在请求中显示重启状态；收到不支持响应时说明当前环境限制，其他失败会展示错误并提供重试或关闭选项。

@bright-y/dsh-restart README · @bright-y/dsh-restart：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

One-click restart button for DeepSeek Harness: a circular-arrow button in the
conversation header's right-side utilities area (next to "Session log") that
relaunches DSH Desktop gracefully after confirmation. No more closing and
reopening the app by hand after installing plugins.

@bright-y/dsh-restart README · What it does：- A bordered capsule button at the top-right of the session header (matching
  the header's own controls and the app theme).
- Clicking it opens a confirm dialog (restart is disruptive — running
  sessions, tasks and unsaved state may be interrupted).
- Confirming POSTs to the loopback-only `/api/dsh-restart/restart` route; the
  host relaunches DSH Desktop via `desktopActions.requestRestart`
  (Electron `app.relaunch`) a beat after the acknowledgement.
- On a plain `dsh web` boot (no desktop shell) the route answers 501 and the
  button explains that one-click restart requires DSH Desktop.

@bright-y/dsh-restart README · Install：After installing, restart `dsh web` and the restart button appears in the
session header.

@bright-y/dsh-restart README · From the release package (.tgz)：Download `dsh-restart-0.1.0.tgz` from the
[Releases](../../releases) page, then:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-restart-0.1.0.tgz
```

@bright-y/dsh-restart README · From the repository (development)：```sh
git clone https://github.com/bright-y/dsh-restart.git
cd dsh-restart
pnpm install
pnpm run build

@bright-y/dsh-restart README · Security model：- The host API is loopback-only: requests from non-local addresses, foreign
  Host headers and cross-site origins are rejected with 403.
- The restart route only exists in a DSH Desktop shell; on other runtimes it
  answers 501 without touching the host.

@bright-y/dsh-restart README · Known limitations：- One-click restart requires DSH Desktop (the Electron shell). On plain
  `dsh web` the button reports that the runtime is unsupported.
- Restart interrupts the current process; any running session/task is
  suspended and resumes after relaunch.
